format: 1-vs-1 snake race on a neon 20x22 grid: two snakes hunt the same orbs (+1), a mid-race star is +4, any crash = BONK, lose 40% of your length and the tail spills as crumbs the rival can eat; first to 30 long wins. Top title + live status line, two race-lane progress bars at the bottom, slow-mo final bite, winner card, loop blend
theme: fire vs ice (elemental pick-a-side 1-vs-1 matchup: favorite with a head start vs the patient underdog; the module's fixed cast, a different family from s1's cute animals)
viral_reason: VARIETY_RULES rule 2 own results (eas.ydata 1-vs-1 'X vs Y' matchups far out-viewed multi-entrant races in the 11-14 Windsor read) + rule 3 evergreen 'which side would you pick' / underdog-vs-favorite matchup; snake_duel takes no cast parameter, so the rerun keeps fire vs ice with a fresh seed. No aislop/research/latest.md trend doc in the project.
music_style: synthwave: 108 bpm B minor, detuned saw pads, saw eighth-note bass, 808 kit (the module's built-in bed; differs from s1's glitch/IDM today); fire bites = warm plucks, ice bites = glass bells, crash thumps + slide-downs, riser into the slow-mo final bite, saw fanfare + bell chord on the card
caption:
Round two, and the snake with the head start is sweating already.

Same neon grid, brand-new board. Every glowing orb adds a segment, the gold star adds four, and one wrong turn into a wall chops off a chunk of tail that the other snake gets to gobble up.

Fire with the early lead, or ice with the patience? Lock in your pick before the first bite.

#snakegame #elementbattle #neonarcade #rematch #fireandice
